subtitle: Beschreiben & Planen
cover.lede: A sofa that stays on the stairs. A tent that takes two minutes, then flies into a lake. A brewery guide who only speaks in the passive, and a car that belongs to somebody else. Twelve chapters, and the German to describe them, plan them and explain why it all went wrong.
cover.real: A cinema listing from 1993, a pharmacy duty board, a summit book, a parking ticket
cover.places: a staircase in Leipzig, a campsite on the Chiemsee, a spa in Baden-Baden, the top of the Zugspitze
